reasoning_content:
All prerequisites match. Let me clean up the test project I created... but wait, I must not edit installation or repair. Creating a project was application runtime data creation — allowed ("normal runtime file creation"). But should I delete it? Deleting would be altering installed state. I'll leave it; it's harmless test data. Actually the boundary says application startup and normal runtime file creation permitted. I'll leave it.

Let me do a final check on all remaining endpoints: Qdrant, MinIO console, Temporal UI already verified. Also check the process-compose project status overall and whether any process is in a failed/error state.

I think I have strong evidence. Let me also quickly confirm the frontend production build is not needed (dev server is the documented flow).

Let me summarize.

Key findings:
- Infra: 11 docker compose containers up; health checks passing (postgres, minio, keycloak, temporal, spicedb).
- App: process-compose 38 processes, 33 Running + 5 Completed(exit 0), 0 failures. 21 restarts on examination was a first-run migration retry, now stable and healthy.
- Endpoints: 3000 (oauth2-proxy → redirect to keycloak), 3002 (vite), 9090 (keycloak), 8233 (temporal UI), 9001 (minio), 6333 (qdrant), 8080 (process-compose).
- E2E login: full OIDC code flow with local user succeeded → landed on app HTML.
- Authenticated API through proxy: project-statuses, projects list, project creation 201.
- Seeds: project_status=5, project_type=1, FCS template_category=3, template_document_type=24, VAE vae_template=1, 159 nodes; law DB norm=2187.
- Temporal worker pollers registered.
- MinIO buckets created.

Limitations:
- LLM and Docling external services are not part of local stack (placeholder endpoints unreachable) — expected, guide says local stack doesn't start them. So can't test the AI extraction/plausibility end-to-end.
- Qdrant has no collections initially (collections created on demand during indexing) — expected.
- Minor: index.html placeholders resolved via VITE_ inlined env / non-`__` runtime fallback; app rendered in tests.

Outcome: success.

Wait — need to double check that the 5 "Completed" seed jobs include gesetzesbegruendung-db and jura-db which are seeds. Yes: administrative-file-draft-seed, formal-completeness-seed, gesetzesbegruendung-db, jura-db, project-logic-seed. All exit 0.

The guide says 3 seed jobs; the actual has 5 seed-like jobs (extra law DB seeds). Fine.

Let me quickly verify jura-db and gesetzesbegruendung-db actually seeded data (they completed). Not strictly needed.

Let me do one final combined check for completeness and then finish.

action.command:
set -a && . /workspace/.env && set +a
for db in jura-db begruendungen-db; do
  echo "=== $db ==="
  docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d "$db" -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public';" 2>&1
done
echo "=== process-compose: any non-running/non-completed? ==="
curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:8080/processes | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const d=JSON.parse(s).data;const bad=d.filter(p=>!["Running","Completed"].includes(p.status)||p.exit_code!==0);console.log("bad:",JSON.stringify(bad.map(p=>({n:p.name,st:p.status,ec:p.exit_code}))));console.log("healthy all:",d.filter(p=>p.has_ready_probe).every(p=>p.is_ready==="Ready"))})'
